docs.title: Model Answers — Pakistan Affairs
headings: 1. Compare Allama Iqbal's philosophical vision with Quaid-i-Azam's political interpretation of the idea of Pakistan.
2. Evaluate the role of Shaikh Ahmad Sirhindi (Mujaddid Alf Sani) in the revival of Islamic thought and Muslim identity in the subcontinent.
3. "The Aligarh Movement was educational in form but political in its effects." Discuss.
4. Critically evaluate the Congress ministries of 1937–39. How far did they pave the way for a separate Muslim homeland?
5. Assess Quaid-i-Azam's leadership of the Muslims of India during the crisis-ridden decade 1937–1947.
6. Analyse the causes and consequences of the separation of East Pakistan in 1971, including the role of regional and global actors. What lessons does it hold?
7. Critically evaluate the federal structure of Pakistan after the 18th Amendment. Why has the amendment come under criticism, and should devolved subjects return to the centre?
8. Why has democracy failed to take root in Pakistan? Discuss with reference to civil–military relations and suggest a way forward.
9. Discuss the crisis of national integration in Pakistan since 1947. How can a diverse, multi-ethnic country strengthen its unity?
10. Identify Pakistan's main economic challenges. How do IMF conditions affect stabilisation and long-term sustainability?
11. Analyse the causes and effects of Pakistan's energy crisis. Is it a failure of strategy and political will? Suggest remedies.
12. "Kashmir is the unfinished agenda of Partition." Evaluate Pakistan's Kashmir policy and discuss whether the dispute exposes the structural weakness of the UN Security Council.
13. How does instability in Afghanistan affect Pakistan's internal security, regional diplomacy and counter-terrorism? Suggest policy measures.

14. Examine how the Indus Waters Treaty of 1960 shaped water sharing and relations between Pakistan and India. What are the implications of India holding it "in abeyance", and what should Pakistan do?
15. Discuss the changing trends in Pakistan–US relations since 2001. What are the prospects for a stable relationship?

docs.title: Model Answers — Islamic Studies
headings: MA-1. What is the difference between Deen and religion? Explain the importance of Deen in human life.
MA-2. What are the rational arguments for the existence of Allah? Explain the effects of belief in Tawhid on human life.
MA-3. What are the Quranic arguments for life after death? Discuss the effects of this belief on the individual and collective life of human beings.
MA-4. Explain the doctrine of Prophethood and its importance in human life. Why is Prophethood final with Muhammad (PBUH)?
MA-5. Write a comprehensive note on the Zakat system of Islam and its spiritual, moral and social effects. How can it reduce poverty?
MA-6. "The Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) was the greatest peacemaker." Discuss with reference to his dealings with the pagans, Jews and Christians. Was peace the real purpose of his military expeditions?
MA-7. Discuss the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) as a military strategist and commander.
MA-8. Analyse the Charter of Madinah (Mithaq al-Madinah) as a social contract.
MA-9. Give a comparative and critical analysis of human rights in Islam and in the Universal Declaration of Human Rights. Refer to the Farewell Sermon.
MA-10. Discuss the status and rights of women in Islam in the context of the modern feminist movement.
MA-11. Explain the concept of self-purification (tazkiyah) and ihsan in the light of the Quran and Sunnah. Why is self-purification essential for the development of society?
MA-12. What are the causes of extremism and terrorism in Pakistan? How can they be eliminated in the light of Islamic teachings?

MA-13. Explain the concept of accountability in Islam. Show with examples that the Rightly Guided Caliphs set the highest standard of accountability. How can Pakistan's system be reformed on these lines?
MA-14. Define Ijtihad. Explain its principles and its importance in the modern world. Can legislation by a parliament take the place of Ijma?
MA-15. Describe the main principles of the Islamic economic system. What are the harms of concentration of wealth, and how does Islam prevent it and eliminate poverty?
